itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Gary J. Anderson', Republican, Office Seeking 'County Commissioner' (NO SEAT LETTER PRINTED ON THE PAGE) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row and carries office 'County Commission Seat A' from the channel's own directory path. The seat is not inferred here; the page face is the name. 5 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('30 Days after the General Election' checked, signature dated 12/2/10, 'Is this report an amendment?' = No, clerk date-received stamp 'DEC 2 AM 8:47'), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (its own 'Page 2 of 5' box), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B, p5 Schedule B continuation ('Page 5 of 5'). The whole filing is a TYPED form (an unusual specimen in this 93%-handwritten corpus) with only the report dates, the p4 page number and the p4 'Total Expenditures Received' figure in hand. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A cells and each Schedule B page independently closes on its own printed subtotal. ONE DOCUMENT ODDITY, retained not adjudicated: Summary line 7 'Balance at Close' prints a typed $0.00 in the cell AND a handwritten '(-$12,152.86)' in the margin beside it; line 5 minus line 6 is 6,538.14 - 18,691.00 = -12,152.86, so the handwritten figure is the formula's own answer and the typed 0.00 is the filer's floor. Both are already recorded verbatim by the 2026-08-01 cover tranche; nothing was recomputed here and neither figure gates an itemized side. PRIVACY: this filing was published UNREDACTED (donor street addresses are legible on p3) — only donor city was carried, per the frozen rule, and no street appears anywhere in this record.
